notes.heading: Limitation on Funds Available to Senate for Fiscal Year Beginning October 1, 1980
notes.text: Pub. L. 96–508, § 10, Dec. 8, 1980, 94 Stat. 2749, provided that in the fiscal year beginning October 1, 1980, the aggregate amount of funds made available to the Senate shall not exceed 90 per centum of the aggregate amount of the funds made available for such purposes for the fiscal year beginning on October 1, 1979.

notes.heading: Senate and House Committee Employees
notes.text: Senate and House committee employees, formerly provided for by this section, are covered by section 4301 of this title.
